integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. The packaged numerical replay is corroborative and is not used as an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the odd anti-Nyquist family N=2m+1 with m>=4, real even coefficients, and sampled nonnegativity on the cyclic grid. It does not address arbitrary grid/frequency pairs or continuous positivity. Residual literature risk remains for older cyclic positive-definite formulations under different notation.
title: Exact anti-Nyquist discrete Carathéodory–Fejér constants on odd cycles
